{{DISPLAYTITLE:Missions in ''Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas''}}
{{spoiler}}


This is a comprehensive list of storyline missions in {{SA}}. There are 101 missions in total, which makes this game the ''[[Grand Theft Auto]]'' singleplayer title with most missions.

==[[Los Santos (3D Universe)|Los Santos]] Missions==
[[Protagonist]] [[Carl Johnson]] returns home to [[Los Santos (3D Universe)|Los Santos]] and needs to reestablish himself in the neighborhood. [[1987|Years previously]], the death of his brother, [[Brian Johnson]], was blamed on him by his elder brother, [[Sweet Johnson|Sweet]], and Carl moved away for a fresh start in [[Liberty City (3D Universe)|Liberty City]]. Following the [[The Introduction|death]] of his [[Beverly Johnson|mother]] in a [[Drive-By Shooting|drive-by shooting]] by the [[Ballas (3D Universe)|Ballas]], he returns and decides to stay for good. Missions involve him working for the prominent members of the [[Grove Street Families]]: his brother Sweet, the childhood friend and junkie [[Ryder]], and cryptic childhood friend, [[Big Smoke]]. Other than those three, CJ participates in illicit street racing with his sister [[Kendl Johnson|Kendl's]] boyfriend, [[Cesar Vialpando]], who faces a lot of prejudice from Sweet, who looks down on Cesar being [[Mexico|Mexican]]. CJ also does missions for [[OG Loc (3D Universe)|OG Loc]], a GSF associate obsessed with his "gangsta" rapper image, but in reality, his crimes range from parking fines to joyriding. Meanwhile, [[C.R.A.S.H.]], led by Officers [[Frank Tenpenny]] and [[Eddie Pulaski]], exploit CJ into doing their dirty work, under the threat of framing him for [[Ralph Pendelbury|Officer Pendelbury's]] murder, which they [[The Introduction|committed themselves]].

There are 29 missions (including the opening sequence) in Los Santos.

==Countryside Missions ([[Red County (3D Universe)|Red County]], [[Flint County (3D Universe)|Flint County]], [[Whetstone]])==
CJ has stumbles onto something that is much bigger than himself. It appears that his childhood friend and fellow Grove Street Families member, Big Smoke, is in an alliance with Tenpenny, and helps demolish the established influence and territory of the GSF—allowing the Ballas to take over as the dominant gang in Los Santos in exchange for money and power. Tenpenny warns CJ to stay away from Big Smoke, otherwise Sweet, who was arrested, will suffer in prison. Tenpenny has a few loose ends that need to be taken care of, and Carl takes care of them while trying to keep himself and his sister out of danger. Unknown to Tenpenny, Carl attempts to gain money and connection through robberies with his sister's boyfriend's cousin, [[Catalina]]. 

There are 14 missions in the countryside (including 4 missions that are cutscenes for the robbery missions).

==[[San Fierro (3D Universe)|San Fierro]] Missions==
CJ is starting to build his own name in San Fierro while still working for Tenpenny. The Truth, who used to be Tenpenny's supplier before he was double-crossed by him, introduces him to certain people with talents to assist him. Woozie, a [[China|Chinese]] [[San Fierro Triads|Triad]] leader whom CJ met at a race, gives him work to further establish himself. With the help of Cesar, The Truth, Woozie, and the others, CJ manages to inflict major damage on the drug trade in Los Santos that provides for Smoke's new empire.

There are 26 missions in San Fierro.

==Desert Missions ([[Tierra Robada]], [[Bone County (3D Universe)|Bone County]])==
Mike Toreno, a member of a clandestine government organization who CJ originally thought to be involved with the drug ring, reveals that it was a decoy of himself that CJ killed previously. Mike reveals that the Loco Syndicate was a front to finance his agency's operations in Latin America. Toreno tells CJ the truth about Tenpenny's crimes. In return for the assurance that Toreno will keep Sweet safe while in prison and will try to use his connections to release him, CJ will need to do missions for him. This will also serve as a way for CJ to make up for sabotaging Toreno's drug peddling operation. Meanwhile, in the desert, The Truth and CJ do missions involving alien cover-ups by the military.

There are 9 storyline missions in the desert.

==[[Las Venturas (3D Universe)|Las Venturas]] Missions==
In Las Venturas, Woozie is about to open a [[The Four Dragons Casino|new casino]], but it becomes clear that the [[Sindacco Family]], 1/3 of the owners of the [[Caligula's Palace|Caligula's Casino]], is trying to sabotage the Four Dragons. CJ and Woozie plot not only to send the Sindaccos a message, but also plan a heist at Caligula's. Meanwhile, Truth's connections lead CJ to [[Ken Rosenberg]], a lawyer in charge of the business dealings of Caligula's, and later on, [[Salvatore Leone]], [[Gang Leaders|Don]] of the [[Leone Crime Family|Leone Family]]. CJ gains the trust of Salvatore to gain inside access, and also to help Ken escape the life-and-death situation of his job. Meanwhile, CJ saves Madd Dogg from attempting to jump from a [[Royal Casino|building]] (after getting drunk due to his career being over - ironically because CJ secretly stole Madd Dogg's rhyme book earlier). 

There are 19 missions in Las Venturas. Six of them are [[Heists|heist]] missions.

==Return to Los Santos Missions==
CJ has it all now. After helping Toreno with illegal government missions, Toreno fulfills his promise and uses his connections to release Sweet. CJ wants Sweet to join him in his casino in Las Venturas and his business in San Fierro, but Sweet refuses and wants to re-establish the GSF territory, and with the help of CJ, he does. Tenpenny gets arrested for his crimes in Los Santos, but with the lack of evidence (Pulaski killed Hernandez, and CJ killed Pulaski and many other people who could be used as key witnesses under Tenpenny's orders), Tenpenny is released, making the people turn Los Santos into a [[Los Santos Riots|rioting city]]. Amidst the dangerous rioters and fires, CJ manages to find Tenpenny and Smoke, kills Smoke, and chases Tenpenny until he gets into a car accident that kills him. 

There are 8 story missions in Los Santos after the return, leading to the end of story.

==Side Missions==
===Vehicle Missions===
*[[Vigilante in GTA San Andreas|Vigilante]] - Complete level 12 to max out armor. Required for [[100% Completion in GTA San Andreas|100%]].
*[[Paramedic in GTA San Andreas|Paramedic]] - Complete level 12 to max out health. Required for 100%.
*[[Firefighter in GTA San Andreas|Firefighter]] - Complete level 12 to become fireproof. Required for 100%.
*[[Taxi Driver in GTA San Andreas|Taxi Driver]] - Complete 50 fares to achieve nitro and boost jump for all taxis. Required for 100%.
*[[Burglar]] - Steal at least $10,000 of goods to achieve infinite sprint. Not required for 100%.
*[[Pimping]] - Complete level 10. Required for 100%.
*[[Freight Train Challenge]] - Complete level 2. Required for 100%.

===Vehicle Challenge Missions===
*[[BMX Challenge]] - Collect 19 checkpoints in [[Glen Park Skate Park]]. Required for 100%.
*[[Lowrider Challenge]] - Participate in a [[Rhythm-based Minigames|Lowrider bouncing challenge]]. Not required for 100%.
*[[The Chiliad Challenge]] - Complete 3 bike races down [[Mount Chiliad (3D Universe)|Mount Chiliad]]. Required for 100%.
*[[NRG-500 Challenge]] - Collect 18 checkpoints in [[Easter Basin]], [[San Fierro (3D Universe)|San Fierro]]. Required for 100%.

===[[Assets in GTA San Andreas|Asset]] Missions===
*[[Courier]] - Deliver packages around all major cities. Required for 100%.
*[[Valet]] - Collect hotel patron cars and park them in the underground parking lot. Required for 100%.
*[[Trucking]] - Complete 8 Trucking missions for [[Mr. Whittaker]]. Required for 100%.
*[[Quarry Missions|Quarry]] - Complete 7 missions for the [[Hunter Quarry]]. Required for 100%.
